reviews.text: What a lovely, well-appointed, welcoming little spot. They were so sweet to my shy, elderly dog on his first visit. I could tell that Miranda was very knowledgeable about canine behavior, but she came across as humble and approachable, and she thoroughly explained the evaluation process. Jimmy Page was well cared for here!

My pup LOVES the Little White Dog Doggie Daycare. He squeals with delight every time we pull into the driveway. He is a high energy dog and the staff manages that energy well. He often falls asleep on the car ride home.
It has also taught him how to get along with other dogs. His breed can be aloof but his interactions at daycare has helped him overcome that.
I highly recommend The Little White Dog and their staff. They do a wonderful job!

There are few people I trust to really take the time to get to know my special pup...and the staff here are certainly among them! There's not a single person I've ever interacted with at LWD that hasn't been incredibly kind, sweet, …

Our pup was having a hard time readjusting to daycare after taking a break for a couple months due to the respiratory virus. The staff at lwd were so patient and accommodating with us. They are simply the best and we are so grateful! …
Best doggie daycare ever. They take such good care of my boy.
